boundary.purpose: Reviewed dependency metadata, not a legal compliance determination
boundary.npm: Verbatim lockfile license declarations; no SPDX interpretation
boundary.go: go.mod requirements plus every go.sum module/version, not a resolved build graph
boundary.evidence: Local extracted Go cache file hashes; not authenticated against go.sum
boundary.native: Reference to the existing native inventory, not native license classification
boundary.exclusions: No installed npm files, OS package licenses, image SBOM, Go standard library, or compatibility evaluation

review.reviewer: Codex maintainer: reviewed compression v1.20.1 evidence, MCP/frontend globals v17.13.0, lucide-react v1.50.0, Node types v24.19.1 and jscpd v5.4.0 metadata; declarations remain unchanged; historical evidence gaps remain acknowledged; Monaco sanitizer DOMPurify v3.4.16 retains its existing dual-license metadata; native PCRE2 minimum metadata aligned to Debian patch deb12u2
review.scope: Metadata and evidence gaps only; no legal or SPDX compatibility assertion
